## Summary
- add Docker Compose services for Next.js app, worker placeholder, Postgres with pgvector, and Redis
- add a dev Dockerfile, .dockerignore, and pgvector init script
- expand .env.example and README with Compose setup/troubleshooting docs

## Verification
- npm run lint
- npm run typecheck
- npm run build
- python3 YAML parse/check for docker-compose.yml services

Note: docker compose config could not be run in this environment because the docker CLI is not installed.
title: Add Docker Compose dev infrastructure
